tariff.err.code_mismatch: The code does not match: the change is different or the plan has changed meanwhile. Show the person the new change (host_tariff action=preview) and repeat with its code
tariff.err.code_needed: Show the change to the person first: host_tariff action=preview gives a code to pass to host_tariff_set
tariff.err.nothing: Nothing to change: give a value or --clear
tariff.err.nothing_panel: Nothing to change: enter a value or clear a field
tariff.err.bad_rev: Wrong version of the plan — reload the page and try again
tariff.err.rev_needed: The version of the plan the page showed is needed — reload the page and try again
tariff.err.rev: The plan was changed in another window or from the command line — reload the page and try again
tariff.err.unknown: the plan has no such field
tariff.help: the server plan: the port speed (for the check «channel at the port limit») and the traffic a month (for the price of the checks)
tariff.help.clear: clear fields, comma-separated (port, traffic), or all
tariff.help.code: the code of --dry: save exactly this change
tariff.help.dry: show the change and its code, save nothing
tariff.help.port_mbit: port speed of the plan, Mbit/s — for the check «channel at the port limit»
tariff.help.set: change the plan (an empty value clears a field)
tariff.help.traffic_gb: traffic of the plan a month, GB, or unlimited — for the price of the checks
tariff.log.epoch: plan: the mark of the new baseline of the checks was not written ({err})
tariff.note.dry: Nothing is saved — this is how it will be after saving
tariff.note.new_base: The port speed has changed — from today the server checks are compared with a new baseline
tariff.note.port_rule: The check «channel at the port limit» takes the new port within 10 s
tariff.note.port_rule_off: Without the plan’s port the check «channel at the port limit» does not run
tariff.title: Server plan
tariff.warn.epoch: The plan is saved, but the mark of the new baseline of the checks could not be written ({err})
